WITH target_supplier AS (
    SELECT s.supplier_id
    FROM suppliers s
    WHERE s.supplier_id IN (
        SELECT p.supplier_id
        FROM products p
        WHERE p.category = 'Electrico'
    )
    ORDER BY s.lead_time_days DESC, s.name ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM products p
JOIN target_supplier ts ON p.supplier_id = ts.supplier_id
WHERE p.category = 'Electrico'

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.category = 'Electrico' THEN d.units ELSE 0 END) / SUM(d.units) FROM sales_daily d JOIN products p ON p.sku = d.sku WHERE d.day >= '2026-07-01' AND d.day < '2026-08-01' AND p.critical

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sd.units), 0)
FROM sales_daily sd
JOIN products p ON sd.sku = p.sku
WHERE p.critical
  AND p.unit_cost > 500
  AND sd.day >= '2026-08-01'
  AND sd.day <= '2026-08-31'
